suite.title: Privacy
body: Experience ultimate privacy and luxury in our master suite, designed as a private sanctuary with an adjacent spacious walk-in closet and an exquisite spa-style bath.
Additionally, the floor features an extra room designed to serve flexibly as a leisure, hosting, or work space, with direct access to the terrace and panoramic views of the city and mountains.

Surrounded by the embassies of Great Britain, France, and Japan.
Near the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

intro.title: PARK VIEW
body: Galaxy Enterprises is a premier developer of luxury real estate in Tbilisi's most prestigious district. We create exclusive properties that blend architectural distinction with exceptional long-term value.

Whether you are looking for a secure investment or a sophisticated urban home, our projects offer the perfect balance. We provide international investors with a stable haven for their capital, and homeowners with a private, safe, and luxurious living environment — all backed by transparent Georgian legislation.
At PARK VIEW, we don't just build — we create spaces designed to protect your wealth while providing an unparalleled lifestyle in the heart of the city.

why.title: Why PARK VIEW
why.body: Galaxy Enterprises is a team that transforms square footage into working capital. We don't just build — we design investment assets in the heart of Tbilisi, where every detail is thought through with profitability and long-term value in mind.

features.title: Secure Gated Community
features.body: A private, safe, and exclusive environment in the heart of the city.

features.title: Prime Urban Living with Garden & Rooftop
features.body: A unique home featuring both a private garden and a rooftop right in the city center.

features.title: Private Elevator Access
features.body: Direct internal elevator access running all the way from the underground parking straight up to the rooftop.

district.title: Ortachala District
district.body: A quiet, private, and secure residential neighborhood of private houses, offering the highest level of security in a gated community with limited access. Located in close proximity to the central bus station and major government institutions.

plan.title: The building in section
plan.body: The architect's sectional drawing shows the whole of PARK VIEW at once: four independent townhouses, each running the full height of the building, cut open to reveal the private stair and elevator that connect every level — from the common subterranean garage up to the planted rooftop terrace.
